title: Super Cup ATTP – Winter 2026: top-level table tennis in Chișinău and memorable wins
excerpt: More than a hundred players from Moldova and abroad took part in the Winter 2026 edition of Super Cup ATTP in Chișinău.
body_html:
The national table tennis tournament Super Cup ATTP - Winter 2026, held in Chișinău on 21-22 February 2026, brought together more than a hundred senior players — amateurs and professionals from the Republic of Moldova and abroad — confirming once again the scale and appeal of this competition format.

The Grand Cup of the Winter 2026 edition was won by master Denis ȚERNA, a member of the Republic of Moldova national team that has qualified for the World Championships in London. In a high-intensity final he played two very tough matches against fellow established masters Evghenii DADECHIN and Veniamin DUBROVIN, winning convincingly to climb to the top of the podium. Second place went to Evghenii Dadechin and the bronze medal to Veniamin Dubrovin.

In Group A the win went to Alexandr GAȘLAMA from Copceac, followed by Alexandr SOLODCHII, who took silver, and Stanislav CASAPCIUC, the bronze medallist.

Group B was won by Ukraine’s Yaroslav VEREMIICHUK, who beat Petru CAPBĂTUT in a long duel and a much-awaited rematch. The bronze medal went to Alexei ROTARI.

In Group C the group favourite, Vsevolod DUBROVIN, lived up to his billing and took first place. The win earns him important points in the overall ranking and opens up a real prospect of promotion to Group B or even A in future editions. Silver went to young debutant Mihail BACIMANOV, and bronze to Ilia NICIC from Bălți, whom the referees consider one of the favourites for future editions of Super Cup ATTP.

In Group D first place went to Alexandr DUPLII, followed by Stefan TANURCOV, who took silver, and Ukraine’s Nazar KUZIN, the bronze medallist.

In Group E, the last qualifying group, the win went to Maxim BURAVȚOV, with silver for Alexandru Bulat and bronze for Mihai MIDORI, after a performance appreciated by the public and the referees.

The Super Cup ATTP - Winter 2026 edition confirmed once again the high level of table tennis in the Republic of Moldova, the positive momentum of the national ranking and players’ growing interest in well-organised, competitive tournaments open to performance.

In addition, for their constant contribution to promoting and popularising table tennis in the Republic of Moldova, the National Association of Professional Table Tennis Players awarded Gold Diplomas to Evghenii Cîlcic (Comrat), Mihail Copusciu (Copceac), Oleksandr Yavorskiy and Alexandr Cosogolov (Chișinău).

Also, Alexandr COSOGOLOV was named Player of the Year 2025, an honorary title awarded by the SETKA Cup project (UA), in recognition of his performance, consistency in competition and active involvement in developing the table tennis community.
